page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmr6e.26xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance featuring 104 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory. Operating on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides a dedicated CPU allocation model, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing. The memory configuration delivers approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per core, positioning it as a memory-dense resource for large-scale enterprise applications.

The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It also lacks integrated GPU accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or GPU-based machine learning workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, supporting high-throughput data transfers. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this server type.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.ebmr6e.26xlarge offers a high density of dedicated compute cores and memory resources within a single virtual machine, reducing the overhead of managing multiple smaller instances. This resource profile is suited for memory-intensive workloads, large-scale databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing applications that require substantial RAM and high vCPU counts but do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
